verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents typo tolerance as a core feature that works without tuning ('phnoe' finds 'phone'; 'even when they misspell… No tuning required'). It is configurable per index, including overriding word-length thresholds via minWordSizeForTypos, and 'typo' is a built-in ranking rule whose position can be reordered. Missing for 10: documentation of other tunable typo rules beyond word-size thresholds (e.g., disabling fuzzy matching for specific words or attributes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of typo-tolerance behavior.
